subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the conflicting fork PR for this Feishu reply-mention bug, or open a fresh target-repo fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but the exact open candidate is outside the target repository, conflicting, and previously reviewed as needing safer mention and root-routing behavior.

options.title: Repair Or Replace Candidate
options.body: Use the existing fork PR as source context but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence, scope-aware routing, and Feishu tests.

options.title: Wait On Fork Author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author to rebase and address the prior safety/proof concerns in their branch.

options.title: Defer Feishu Reply Work
options.body: Leave the bug open without a new repair lane until a Feishu channel owner has bandwidth to validate the mention and routing semantics.

recommendation.title: Repair Or Replace Candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing fork PR as source context but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence, scope-aware routing, and Feishu tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the Feishu mention/parser split makes this the best available routing candidate for the adoption or replacement choice.
